detect_dangerous_command: detect if a shell command matches dangerous patterns and return the pattern key and description
check_dangerous_command: check if a command is dangerous and handle approval via CLI or gateway flow
check_all_command_guards: run combined tirith and dangerous-command security checks with a single approval decision
prompt_dangerous_approval: prompt the user interactively to approve or deny a dangerous command with once/session/always options
load_permanent_allowlist: load permanently allowed command patterns from config.yaml into the approval module
